description: We are three INSAT students with a shared interest in robotics, embedded systems, electronics, and innovative technologies. Our team values creativity, collaboration, and learning through hands-on experience. We are interested in exploring new challenges, experimenting with different technologies, and developing solutions that can have a real impact.
summary:
BSZ-OS is a rich, modular, adaptive, user-friendly and all-encompassing health platform for our astronauts in any extraterrestrial environment, covering the entire lifecycle of a health checkup; early detection and prevention, addressing the astronaut's issues as they arise and conducting periodic checkups.
It tackles the current vagueness accompanied with the assembly of a full health profile on an astronaut by gathering all the data in one centralized platform that intelligently interprets the data and reacts to it.
Such a piece of software is necessary in real-world applications due to the importance of the upkeep of astronauts' health, both mental and physical, to maximize their performance. Apps like this also possess a load-bearing role in the sense that they handle the full responsibility of health checkups in a non-tiresome manner, ensuring astronauts can worry less and consecrate more time to the mission.
details:
BSZ-OS (short for Blood, Sweat and ZeroG's - Operating System) is a comprehensive & multimodal health platform ensuring quality and precision off the grid and with no connectivity, keeping everything local and hosted on the user's machine. The lifecycle of a health check-up is as follows:

  1. Different types of data about the astronaut's health are gathered: musculoskeletal (bone density, grip strength, etc...), motor skills & functions (reaction time, balance, etc..), sensory functions, periodic mood checkups and overall mental health, and so on.
  2. Data is ingested into the database for historical records, visualized on graphs, embedded through the use of an embedding model and eventually used to empower the output of an offline chatbot.
  3. If need be, a rapid and locally-hosted chatbot is quick to provide answers to questions the astronaut may have. It is a smaller LLM (3b parameters) fine-tuned on patient cases given in real medical school exams; it is basically a MISO (multi-input single-output) system of sorts; able to ingest multiple symptoms and reply with the most reasonable analysis. It packs quite a punch for its small and portable format, having a massive knowledge-base backed by sources of truth such as the WHO. The rapidity also ensures medical emergencies are addressed as best as possible in the absence of real medical personnel.
  4. The astronaut is given actionable tips depending on their case. They may as well follow an exercise regimen also provided in the health section - packed with visual tracking.

The benefits that come with BSZ-OS are its centralization of all the features and its ease-of-use. In a more sophisticated and developed form, it could eventually interface with all kinds of sensors through its sensor engine (for now, it only sends simulated data back to the other engines due to the absence of most of the instrumentation that would be onboard in a spaceship or space station.)

Our design language is rooted in aesthetics & accessibility, offering beautiful and variable themes high-contrast themes for people who may need it.


Through BSZ-OS, we intend to revolutionize how astronauts address their health by having it come along all their missions and throughout their careers. It gives them the opportunity to direct their attention mainly towards the mission, letting go of the worries that arise when health tracking is decentralized and short-term.

VSCode was our code editor of choice. We used HTML, CSS and JS to develop the frontend that runs on a Python backend (standard library, ZERO frameworks). The SQL flavor of choice for the database is SQLite, since it can be imported easily into Python.

BSZ-OS expresses creativity through its ability to gather so many features together yet keep everything cohesive all without overwhelming the user. From live motor-function tests to 3D space-themed Chess games, it has it all! The themes also differ substantially in their feel, so find whichever one suits you best.
